§6Particle Accelerator: Products§f

§aFrom chicken nuggets to digamma particles. Every recipe the accelerator can make.§f

Each recipe needs a §bParticle Detector§f at the receiving end. Particles must have §e0 defocus§f. Every recipe has a §escore threshold§f determined by ring size and coil tier.

§6Recipes§f:
§b•§f §bAntimatter Capsule§f, H Ion + Cu Ion, score §e300§f, yields 1000 mB antimatter
§b•§f §bAntischrabidium Capsule§f, 2x Antimatter, score §e400§f
§b•§f §bMuon Capsule§f, Antimatter + H Ion, score §e2,500§f
§b•§f §bHiggs Boson Capsule§f, Pb Ion + H Ion, score §e6,500§f, transmutes U-238 to schrabidium
§b•§f §bDark Matter Capsule§f, 2x Antischrabidium, score §e10,000§f, transmutes Pu to euphemium
§b•§f §bStrange Quark Capsule§f, Dark Matter + Muon, score §e12,500§f, makes Dark Crystal
§b•§f §bSparkticle Capsule§f, Pulverized Enchantment + Strange Quark, score §e12,500§f, makes dineutronium
§b•§f §bDigamma Particle§f, Higgs Boson + Sparkticle, score §e70,000§f, RBMK Digamma fuel

§ePS:§f Higher score means bigger ring. Digamma needs §e70,000§f, so you need a massive synchrotron with Chlorophyte coils. Plan your ring layout around your target recipes.
